problems.name: Model frequently includes extra columns not requested (breaking execution accuracy checks) and sometimes outputs natural language instead of pure SQL in the final block, causing syntax errors.

attempts.what: Update system prompt to strictly forbid extra columns and require pure SQL output. Enhance extract_sql to handle cases where the model forgets code fences by attempting to identify SQL keywords at the start of lines.
